cohort: Primigravida women undergoing cesarean section (some due to obstructive labor, some elective)
finding: Levels of MMP-9 and MMP-2 were increased, and TIMP-1 levels were decreased, in the uterosacral ligament of primigravida women who underwent cesarean section due to obstructive labor at stage 1 and 2 compared to women who were not in labor.
gest_age: Term for the control group, unspecified for the labor group
